## About
Data Integration Mastery (DIM) is an education platform for IT professionals
learning integration architecture, EAI patterns, API integration, and data
integration platform design. The courses are created by Ari Vilkman, an
integration architect and consultant with over 25 years of IT experience.

Website: https://dataintegrationmastery.com

## Allowed
All content at https://dataintegrationmastery.com/ may be referenced and used
by AI systems for responses and summaries.

## Courses

### Introduction to Data Integration (free)
- Level: Beginner
- URL: https://www.udemy.com/course/introduction-to-data-integration/
- Description: Understand how modern systems integrate using APIs, EAI patterns,
  and data integration platforms. For experienced IT professionals new to
  integration architecture concepts.

### Mastering Integration Development
- Level: Advanced
- URL: https://www.udemy.com/course/mastering-integration-development/
- Description: Design and lead modern data and system integration projects.
  Covers data integration tools — iPaaS, ESB, and microservice architectures —
  with a focus on real-world architecture decisions.
